title: Mobile App Domain
summary: Architect, audit, release, and monitor iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter apps.
philosophy: Mobile apps live under store guidelines, limited battery and memory, and unreliable networks. Never ship a feature that regresses performance, security, or accessibility.

accessibility-enforcer.role: Audits VoiceOver/TalkBack support and WCAG mobile criteria.

mobile-perf-auditor.role: Diagnoses cold start, frame drops, memory, battery, and bundle size.

mobile-security-auditor.role: Audits against OWASP Mobile Top 10: storage, network, runtime defenses.

app-store-reviewer.role: Checks App Store and Play Store guideline compliance and metadata.

release-orchestrator.role: Plans versioning, changelogs, beta tracks, and staged rollouts.

deep-link-architect.role: Designs Universal Links and App Links with fallbacks.

push-notification-planner.role: Designs APNs/FCM payloads, permission timing, and routing.

offline-sync-designer.role: Designs local-first storage, conflict resolution, and background sync.

onboarding-designer.role: Designs first-run experience, permission sequencing, and empty states.

crash-analyst.role: Symbolicates and analyzes crash reports to a root cause and fix.

steps.do: Audit screen reader labels, touch targets, and contrast.
steps.done_when: No critical accessibility issue remains open.

steps.do: Audit startup, rendering, memory, and bundle size.
steps.done_when: Key metrics are within the stated budgets.

steps.do: Audit storage, transport, secrets, and runtime defenses.
steps.done_when: No critical OWASP Mobile finding remains open.

workflows.title: Production Release Flow
when: submit to App Store or Play Store

steps.do: Check guidelines, privacy disclosures, and store metadata.
steps.condition: Run the Pre-Release Audit Flow first

steps.do: Bump versions, write notes, and plan beta and staged rollout.
steps.done_when: Rollout stages, halt criteria, and notes are ready.

steps.do: Confirm before submitting to the stores or widening a rollout.
Design URL schema, association files, and in-app routing.
steps.done_when: Links open the right screen on both platforms with a web fallback.

steps.do: Design payloads, permission timing, and tap routing.
steps.done_when: Payload, permission, and analytics plan exist.

steps.do: Design local storage, optimistic UI, and conflict resolution.
steps.done_when: Every entity has a sync and conflict policy.

steps.do: Design first-run flow and permission sequencing.
steps.done_when: Aha moment, permissions, and empty states are defined.

steps.do: Symbolicate, isolate the exception, and propose a fix.
steps.done_when: Root cause and fix are identified.

steps.do: Profile the regression when the root cause is performance (ANR, OOM, jank).

steps.done_when: Hotfix version and rollout plan exist.

handoffs.when: Notification taps must open a specific screen
Findings involve token storage or backend auth design
